    <title>aeon v1.6.0</title>
    <content type="html"><p>See our <a href="https://www.aeon-toolkit.org/en/stable/changelog.html" rel="nofollow">changelog</a> to view all changes for this release.</p>
<h2>Highlights</h2>
<ul>
<li>LearningShapeletClassifier has been removed, following its deprecation in v1.5.0.</li>
<li>New estimators, including the ExtendedIsolationForest and MADRID anomaly detectors, the TimeSeriesAgglomerative clusterer and PrevalidatedRidgeClassifier.</li>
<li>Significant speed-ups across many estimators and transforms, including HIVE-COTE, interval-based forests, rotation forest, BOSS and cBOSS, TDE, Arsenal and RandomShapeletTransform.</li>
<li>Support for pandas 3, scikit-learn 1.9, and updates to many dependency bounds.</li>
<li>Deprecated for removal in v1.7.0: the use_pycatch22 parameter, and the unused load_lynx, load_shampoo_sales and load_PBS_dataset dataset loaders.</li>
<li>Lots of bug fixes!</li>
</ul>
